title: Soul Craft
description: The Soul Craft mod immerses you in a world of mysticism and soul energy! Collect souls, discover new resources like Soul Powder, and craft powerful artifacts like the Priest's Scythe or upgraded Soul Collectors to harness the power of the fall!
body:
Welcome to Soul Craft, a mod that will open up unexplored depths of magic and power! Immerse yourself in a world where every soul of a hostile mob becomes the key to new opportunities.


Soul Craft gives you a unique opportunity to create Diamond and Non-Cerite Soul Collectors. These outlandish mechanisms will tirelessly collect the essence of fallen enemies, turning their souls into a valuable resource. Imagine: every defeated zombie, skeleton, or even powerful creeper is now not just a source of experience, but a source of raw materials for your greatest creations!


But this is just the beginning! Melt the collected souls in the furnace, and they will turn into sparkling Soul Powder. This powder is the basis for creating something truly special. Combine it with the usual ingots of iron, and you will receive a Soul Ingot, a material endowed with unknown power.


What can be created with the help of this mysterious ingot? Get ready to face the Priest's Scythe! This formidable tool, created from two ingots of lead, two sticks and one precious Soul Ingot, will become your faithful companion in battles.


The scythe of a Priest is not just a weapon, it is an artifact with two amazing properties.:


Levitation: With each blow, your enemy will experience a dizzying bounce, losing control of the situation.

Enemy Illumination: A glow effect will be applied to the affected enemy, making it visible even in pitch darkness and making it easier to aim.


Soul Craft is not just a mod, it's a whole adventure where your ingenuity and desire for new knowledge will be rewarded. Discover the power of souls, conquer your enemies and become a true master of the magic craft!


Download Soul Craft right now and start your journey to the heights of power!
